recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three men in early 90s streetwear, arranged in a triangular crouching formation against a solid, vibrant blue backdrop. The central figure wears a bright yellow quilted jacket, flanked by two others in dark apparel. Bold, red stencil-style typography is stacked at the top, while a flame icon and secondary text anchor the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular composition with the central figure as the apex
High contrast between the yellow jacket and the deep blue background
Symmetry between the top-heavy red typography and the bottom-centered flame icon
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subjects' presence

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame; central figure is slightly larger and forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow quilted jacket in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red text at the top, moves down to the yellow jacket, and settles on the flame icon at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat blue at the top corners and sides provide breathing room for the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue background providing a high-energy, flat field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow jacket and white floor creating a sharp break from the blue.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used for all primary typographic elements and the flame icon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary colors (Red, Yellow, Blue) with high value contrast between the floor and the subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary colors plus black and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, wide sans-serif with stencil-like cutouts.
letterConstructionRules: Geometric stencil gaps in vertical and horizontal strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Brackets used to enclose specific text lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace or wide geometric sans for secondary metadata at the bottom.
graphicDevices: Stylized flame icon with sharp, vertical licks

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky feel if manually modified.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photo of three men in 90s streetwear (one in a yellow quilted jacket) crouching on a white floor against a solid cobalt blue background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of heavy, red, horizontally-stretched stencil text at the top center. Place a red flame icon at the bottom center with a single line of spaced-out black text underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, solid blue?
Are the subjects in a crouching/squatting pose?
Is the typography red and stencil-like?
Is there a flame icon at the bottom center?

adjustableVariables: Subject clothing colors (keep one bright primary)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for horizontal stretching in the top text
Ensure the blue background is uniform and vibrant
Verify the triangular arrangement of the three subjects
Confirm the presence of the bottom flame graphic
recipe.reuseFormula: 90s Urban Portrait = [Solid Primary Background] + [Crouching Subjects in Streetwear] + [Stretched Stencil Typography] + [High Contrast Lighting]
